Account summary:
- Company: Orbitus Cascade Intelligence — enterprise support platform powering chat + ticket deflection for 3rd-party help centers.
- Primary ask: replace current vector-search + heuristic ranker with RAG pipeline that hits top-5 quality for suggested replies and reduces human escalations.
- Scale: ~25M indexed knowledge docs (kb articles, past tickets, macros); ingestion ~40-60k new signals/day (tickets + articles). Need incremental indexing.
- Latency SLOs: end-to-end user query -> top-5 rerank <= 250ms p95; optim target 150-200ms. Reranker itself target <=100ms p95.
- Cost target: <$0.005/query (embeddings + ANN + rerank amortized). Very cost sensitive — wants cost-per-deflection metric.
- Model preferences: open/quantized reranker (mistral/llama family OK), embedding model tradeoff: dense 1536 vs 3072 dims; prefers provided benchmark on both latency and cost.
- Routing/fallbacks: prefer primary dedicated cluster in us-east, fallback to hosted compatible smaller model variants if capacity constrained. Automatic reroute by latency policy desirable.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required; SSO (SAML + SCIM); audit logs and KMS integration; data residency: US only. On-prem eval requested for air-gapped CX environments.
- Quote from head of CS: "We need the suggestions to be accurate enough that agents accept them 70%+ — and any extra latency above ~300ms kills adoption."
- Current stack: Elastic for search + proprietary reranker (slow at scale); experimenting with Pinecone for ANN.
- POC ask: 6-week POC demo: 1) ingest 2M docs, 2) measure p50/p95 retrieval+rerank, 3) tune batch sizes and KV caching, 4) show cost-per-deflection calculation.
- Red flags: legal wants exact egress map; infra team concerned about VPC peering and private link; performance engineering wants kernel-level profiling.
